article.story: PROVIDENCE, R.I. -- — Adrian Uchidiuno had 13 points in Brown's 75-56 win over Bryant on Friday. Uchidiuno shot 5 for 9, including 3 for 5 from beyond the arc for the Bears (4-6). Jeremiah Jenkins scored 12 points and added five rebounds, six assists and three steals. Landon Lewis shot 5 of 14 from the field to finish with 11 points, while adding seven rebounds. The Bulldogs (3-7) were led in scoring by Ty Tabales, who finished with 19 points. Quincy Allen added 15 points and three blocks for Bryant. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
